text.en:
The first paragraph of subsection (d) of section fourteen hundred and ninety-nine of Act
Numbered Twenty-seven hundred and eleven, known as the Administrative Code, as amended, is hereby

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, December 2, 1924.
